bio_am: Սասնոյ Գելիէգուզան գիւղացի հայդուկ, Գէորգ Չաւուշի զինակից։ Մահացած է Համադան՝ 1949 Դեկտեմբեր 6-ին։
bio_en: Karapet Avoyan, known as Moruk ('Bearded') Karo, was born in Geliguzan in Sasun and studied for three years at the school of the Arakelots monastery in Mush. At 18-19 he went to Tiflis to obtain a proper weapon, worked at the Mantashev factory and joined the ARF, later carrying out party missions to Van. In 1903 he entered Taron via Basen and joined Gevorg Chavush's band; he was wounded in the 1904 Sasun uprising and evaded capture after Chavush fell at Sulukh in 1907. He survived the 1915 struggle in Sasun, returned to Soviet Armenia in 1924, escaped the Cheka and reached Persia in 1930, and died suddenly in Hamadan on 6 December 1949, aged about 80.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Age 'about 80' at death implies birth c.1869 (not stated).
